triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: I didn’t dare even to tell Alyosha, my brother, about that fifteen hundred: I felt I was such a scoundrel and such a pickpocket.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: well, in fact, when I’d just come to love another, her, she’s sitting down below now, Grushenka.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: You see, a month ago, I was sent for by Katerina Ivanovna, formerly my betrothed. Do you know her?

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Many people have already guessed, during this last month, about the three thousand of Katerina Ivanovna’s, that you have spent, and I heard the legend myself, apart from your confession....

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: it was fifteen hundred roubles, and I had it on me all the time, all the time ...

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: I carried her off here to Mokroe then, and wasted here in two days half that damned three thousand, but the other half I kept on me.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: returning that fifteen hundred to the lady who had entrusted it to you

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: I made up my mind to tear my amulet off my neck, on my way from Fenya’s to Perhotin.

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: she’d have given it to satisfy her vengeance, to show her contempt for me, for hers is an infernal nature, too, and she’s a woman of great wrath.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Mihail Makarovitch and Kalganov, who had been continually in and out of the room all the while the interrogation had been going on, had now both gone out again.

triples.subject: Mihail Makarovitch

triples.subject: Nikolay Parfenovitch
triples.quote: “May I look out of the window?” he asked Nikolay Parfenovitch, suddenly. “Oh, as much as you like,” the latter replied.
